searchText: Isn't the current best practice to smear the leap second over a day or even longer It creates some discrepancy but also prevents total failure I don't know enough about the smearing to say whether it affects time difference or not. If it does, things can get a little interesting. Not necessarily for Ethereum I think (with 4 second windows I'd think it's still mostly fine even if affected by smearing), but for faster-paced clones/alternatives, especially those that need a certain percentage of validators to agree before the chain can progress... maybe it is not. Smearing is only done in a few very specialized scenarios.
